title: Mixed Event — Time to hang out♪ — Episode4 To Stand Proud Next to Them

meta.Episode: Episode4 — To Stand Proud Next to Them
meta.Event Outline: Upon hearing Minori's eagerness to ask An what it was like growing up with Haruka, Kohane suggests a day out for the four of them. On the day of, both Minori and Kohane learn the true depth of An and Haruka's friendship...

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for sharing so much with us, An, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I mean, you're welcome, but you're happy with just that...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We really didn't tell you two that much, you know?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: For you, sure, but I got to learn more about a part of Haruka that I never knew about, so I'm really glad you told us all this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm filled with a mix of joy knowing more about little Haruka and sadness for not being able to witness her back then!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: H-Hold on, sadness?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. You're hilarious, Minori!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry, that's my phone...
I think it's my dad calling.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to use the restroom while you do that. Sorry, I'll be right back.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, we'll be here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They've really been friends forever, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, they really have!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm happy about learning so much about An's past, but that feeling from before is still lingering...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That was so much fun.
Haruka being so competitive and taking singing so seriously back then explains so much...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm so jealous...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm jealous of not being her childhood friend, but also jealous of how they look so good together! It's unfair how well they mirror each other...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is that what I've been feeling...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(Seeing Haruka and An in this light...
Learning about how they see everything eye-to-eye...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Am I jealous...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry...
I... I think I feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, you too?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, because An's always there to help me. I think a part of me wishes that I could challenge her the way Haruka does...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel like I should be doing that as her partner, and supporting her in every way I can...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I know... I know exactly how you feel!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I wish I could help Haruka more, I wish I could work as hard as her and I wish I looked as good standing next to her as An does!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We may not be able to overcome the bond they've developed...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But that doesn't change how I feel about Haruka! It just makes me want to try even harder! More and more!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
I need to try harder to make sure An sees me as a partner she can be proud of!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ugh, Dad, why?
Making me pick stuff up on my way home...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, An, how was your call...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa, Haruka, hey! Same old, same old, you know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, Minori's so cute!
Did you see the way her eyes sparkled while hearing about you from back then?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She has a habit of doing that, but I do appreciate the way she shows just how much she cares about me when we're together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You probably mean everything to her...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, stop...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But Kohane seemed just as interested in you, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm still not really sure what she'll get from hearing about my past.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Regardless, she seemed keen to find out.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to learn more about Minori too. What she was like before we met or the things she used to do when she was little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
I think I'll ask Kohane the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'd like to know too.
We could conceivably sneak that conversation in today if we have time.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we'll just have to play that by ear!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, you two.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About our next stop...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Right. We should start making our way towards PXL!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Wait, it's already that late?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We were there for a while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry, I lost track of time back there. Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Haruka!
We have a PXL Master right here!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: PXL Master?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: “Master” might be a bit too far, but you can leave everything PXL-related to me...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I promise to make sure you all get to have fun and enjoy yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! I'll be your personal escort, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Th-Thanks.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They seem pretty fired up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, they really must've been looking forward to this.
